_doc: Touchstone passes per module that CI must keep (check-floor.py). Raise with the change that earns it.
_supported_doc: Each *-when-unsupported test that probes the absence of a feature this server supports: the precondition, by its label, that finds the feature advertised; the assertion of it that fails, by its description and what it expects; and the pattern the value that assertion got must match. It counts toward its module's floor only when inapplicable for exactly that reason; a pass, any other outcome or reason, or its absence fails the check.

core/linksets#linkset-put-405-when-unsup.precondition: the linkset does not advertise PUT (otherwise this test does not apply)
